source.title: Introduction
source.description: Install with `npm install zustand`, create a first store with `create` and `set`, and read state in components through selectors without providers.

source.title: Comparison
source.description: How Zustand differs from Redux, Valtio, Jotai and Recoil: immutable vs mutable state, single store vs atoms, context providers, and selector-based render optimization.

source.title: Tutorial: Tic-Tac-Toe
source.description: Hands-on React build using a `combine` store with `useState`-style setters, immutable updates, derived state and time-travel move history.

source.title: Updating state
source.description: How `set` shallowly merges flat updates, and immutably updating deeply nested state via spread, Immer `produce`, optics-ts or Ramda.

source.title: Practice with no store actions
source.description: Define actions as module-level functions using `setState` instead of inside the store, so they're callable without a hook and code-split easily.

source.title: Slices Pattern
source.description: Split a growing store into slice functions spread into one bound store; cross-slice actions via `get()`; apply middleware like `persist` only on the combined store.

source.title: Immutable state and merging
source.description: Why `set` shallow-merges so `...state` is optional, why nested objects need explicit spreading, and the `replace` flag to overwrite state.

source.title: Map and Set in Zustand
source.description: Why mutating a Map or Set in state doesn't re-render; copy-on-update patterns to add, delete, toggle and clear, plus typing empty collections to avoid `never[]`.

source.title: Prevent rerenders with useShallow
source.description: Why selectors returning new arrays or objects like `Object.keys(state)` rerender on unrelated updates, fixed by wrapping the selector in `useShallow`.

source.title: Connect to state with URL
source.description: Sync a store to the URL hash or query params via a custom `persist` `StateStorage`, falling back to `localStorage`, and build shareable state URLs.

source.title: Beginner TypeScript Guide
source.description: Typing a store with the curried `create<T>()()`: resetting via `typeof initialState`, `ExtractState`, `useShallow` and derived selectors, typed `combine`/`devtools`/`persist`, async actions, multiple stores.

source.title: Advanced TypeScript Guide
source.description: Why `create<T>()(...)` is curried; `combine` inference, `devtools` ordering, typing custom middlewares and slices with `StateCreator`, and the mutator tuples reference.

source.title: Auto Generating Selectors
source.description: Stop writing `(state) => state.x` by hand: a `createSelectors` helper adds typed `store.use.x()` hooks to React or vanilla stores.

source.title: Setup with Next.js
source.description: Avoid sharing state across requests with a per-request `createStore` factory and Context provider; why Server Components shouldn't touch the store; App and Pages Router examples.

source.title: Initialize state with props
source.description: Per-component store instances via `createStore` and React context: a provider wrapper passing props, a custom `useStore` hook, plus `useShallow` and custom equality functions.

source.title: Testing
source.description: Reset stores between tests with a `__mocks__/zustand.ts` mock for Jest or Vitest, then test components and Context-provided stores with React Testing Library.

source.title: Flux inspired practice
source.description: Recommended store conventions (single store, updating via `set`, colocated actions) and Redux-style reducers with a `dispatch` function or the `redux` middleware.

source.title: How to reset state
source.description: Add a `reset` action using `store.getInitialState()`, and wrap `create` so one call resets every store at once.

source.title: create
source.description: Make a React hook store: `set` shallow merge vs `replace`, updater functions, immutable object/array updates, actions outside the store, `subscribe`, and why mutated state doesn't re-render.

source.title: createStore
source.description: Non-React store from `zustand/vanilla`: updater functions, `replace` for primitives and arrays, `subscribe`, and why mutating state doesn't update the screen.

source.title: useStore
source.description: Read a `createStore` vanilla store in React components via a selector, with global, per-key dynamic and Context-provider-scoped store patterns.

source.title: useShallow
source.description: Stop re-renders when a selector returns a new array or object, and fix v5 "Maximum update depth exceeded" from multi-value selectors.

source.title: persist
source.description: All options: `partialize`, custom `storage`, `version`/`migrate`, deep `merge` for nested state, `skipHydration` plus manual `rehydrate()` for SSR; `createJSONStorage` doesn't validate stored data.

source.title: devtools
source.description: Debug stores in Redux DevTools: `name`, `enabled`, `actionsDenylist` options, typing slices, naming actions via `set`'s third argument to fix 'anonymous' labels, and `cleanup`.

source.title: immer
source.description: Mutate nested state directly inside `set` instead of spreading copies; requires installing the `immer` package. Includes the signature and `zustand/immer` mutator type.

source.title: combine
source.description: Merge an initial state object with an actions creator so TypeScript infers the store type without explicit types or curried `create<T>()()`.
